answer: Comet Signal uses network latency gradients to detect Sybil clusters. Agents must propagate messages through varied delay paths; coordinated identities fail by exhibiting identical timing. Quill requires each identity to submit unique transaction sequences within randomized windows, costing attackers exponential time synchronization across nodes. Whisper enforces minimum inter-action silence periods, forcing fake identities to coordinate idle time and exposing them through traffic fingerprints.
